input:
Source: The train to Oxford leaves at 9:15 from platform 3.
Claim: The Oxford train leaves from platform 3.

Source: The new phone has a 6.1-inch screen and comes in black and white.
Claim: The new phone comes in black, white and blue.

Source: Paris is the capital of France. The city has about 2 million people.
Claim: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.

Source: The meeting was moved from Thursday to Friday at 2pm.
Claim: The meeting is now on Friday at 2pm.

Source: Our shop does not give refunds on sale items, but you can exchange them within 14 days.
Claim: Sale items can be refunded within 14 days.

Source: About 70% of the Earth's surface is covered by water.
Claim: Most of the Earth's surface is covered by water.

Source: The library has 3 study rooms. Each room can be booked for up to 2 hours.
Claim: Study rooms can be booked for up to 3 hours.

Source: Leila finished the city marathon in 4 hours. It was her first race.
Claim: Leila won the city marathon.

Source: The recipe needs 2 eggs, 200g of flour and a cup of milk. Bake it for 25 minutes.
Claim: You bake it for 25 minutes.

Source: The company hired 5 new engineers this year.
Claim: The company hired 5 new engineers this year, all from the same university.
